test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: How much amount will be received on a principal of Rs. 21500 at the rate of 35 percent per annum compounded annually for 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 21500

Rate (R) = 35% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)T

**Calculation:**

A = 21500(1 + 35/100)²

A = 21500(1 + 0.35)²

A = 21500(1.35)²

A = 21500 × 1.8225

⇒ A = 39183.75

**The amount received will be Rs. 39183.75.**
